categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies LoadBody() in the HTTP server along with HTTP test harnesses.
categories.rationale: Enforces RFC 9112 section 6.3 compliance by rejecting unsupported Transfer-Encoding headers with HTTP 400. This resolves HTTP body framing inconsistencies when handling multiple or unsupported transfer codings like gzip.
